correctness.rationale: Split disjunction entailment sufficiency follows directly from a perfect matching of individual FD implications. Necessity uses Hall obstruction for a 2x2 bipartite graph. If one source implies no target, an F3 pair-coordinate grid team satisfying that source has each target maximum FD-subteam size <=|T|/3. Otherwise both sources only imply the same target: disjoint tagged grids give target maxima <=|T|/2 and <=|T|/3, so no two-target cover exists. This handles nontrivial FD consequents outside determinants including empty determinants. Independent exact density calculations validated 97 sampled nonmatching cases on three attributes. Infinite-domain equivalence follows from the general finite witness construction, not the random tests.
